unitTitle: Past Simple - A/An/The - Will - Linking Words

exercises.instructionEn: Past Simple: regular verbs — the table.
exercises.instructionUz: Oddiy o'tgan zamon: to'g'ri fe'llar — jadval.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL:

  TASDIQ           SO'ROQ              INKOR
  I worked         Did I work?         I didn't work
  you worked       Did you work?       you didn't work
  he worked        Did he work?        he didn't work
  she worked       Did she work?       she didn't work
  it worked        Did it work?        it didn't work
  we worked        Did we work?        we didn't work
  you worked       Did you work?       you didn't work
  they worked      Did they work?      they didn't work

QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Did I/you/he, etc work ...?
     → Yes, I/you/he, etc DID.
     → No,  I/you/he, etc DIDN'T.

ENG MUHIM UCH KUZATUV:

  1) TASDIQda fe'l HAMMA EGA uchun BIR XIL —
     'worked'. Hech qanday -s yo'q.
        he workeds  ✗ XATO

  2) SO'ROQ va INKORda fe'l ASOSIY shaklda —
     'work' ('worked' EMAS).
        Did he worked?    ✗ XATO
        He didn't worked? ✗ XATO

  3) QISQA javobda faqat 'did/didn't' —
     asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI.
        Yes, I worked.  ✗
        Yes, I did.     ✓

SABABI: 'did' allaqachon O'TGAN zamonni ko'rsatgan.
Bir gapda o'tgan zamon IKKI MARTA ko'rsatilmaydi.

points.en: I worked — Did I work? — I didn't work
points.noteUz: Tasdiqda 'worked', so'roq va inkorda 'work'.

points.en: you worked — Did you work? — you didn't work
he worked — Did he work? — he didn't work
points.noteUz:
DIQQAT: -S YO'Q ('he workeds' XATO).
Hozirgi zamonda 'he works' edi, o'tganda farq yo'q.

points.en: she worked — Did she work? — she didn't work
it worked — Did it work? — it didn't work
we worked — Did we work? — we didn't work
you worked — Did you work? — you didn't work
they worked — Did they work? — they didn't work
Yes, I/you/he, etc did. — No, I/you/he, etc didn't.
points.noteUz: Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI.

exercises.instructionEn: Form — how we make the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Yasalishi — oddiy o'tgan zamon qanday hosil bo'ladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI TO'RT QOIDA:

  1) Ko'pchilik TO'G'RI fe'lning TASDIQ shaklini
     fe'lga -ED qo'shib yasaymiz.
        I work  →  I worked

  2) Boshqa fe'llarning NOTO'G'RI tasdiq shakli bor.
        I see  →  I saw
     (Kitobning oxiridagi noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxatiga qarang.)

  3) Oddiy o'tgan zamonning SO'ROQ shaklini
     DID + KISHILIK OLMOSHI + FE'LNING ASOSIY SHAKLI
     bilan yasaymiz.
        DID HE WORK yesterday?
        DID YOU SEE Tom yesterday?

  4) INKOR shaklini DIDN'T + FE'LNING ASOSIY SHAKLI
     bilan yasaymiz.
        I DIDN'T WORK yesterday.
        I DIDN'T SEE Tom yesterday.

  5) Ijobiy qisqa javobni DID bilan,
     salbiy qisqa javobni DIDN'T bilan yasaymiz.
        Did you call me?  →  Yes, I DID.
        Did he tell you?  →  No, he DIDN'T.

DIQQAT — 3 va 4-QOIDALARDAGI ENG MUHIM SO'Z:
  'BASE FORM OF THE VERB' = fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.
  Ya'ni lug'atdagi shakl: work, see, go, have.
  O'tgan shakl EMAS: worked, saw, went, had.

  NOTO'G'RI FE'LLARDA bu ayniqsa muhim:
     Did you SEE Tom?    ✓
     Did you SAW Tom?    ✗ XATO
     I didn't SEE Tom.   ✓
     I didn't SAW Tom.   ✗ XATO

points.en: We form the affirmative of most regular verbs by adding -ed to the verb. I work - I worked
points.uz: Ko'pchilik to'g'ri fe'lning tasdiq shaklini -ed qo'shib yasaymiz.
points.noteUz: KITOBDAGI 1-QOIDA.

points.en: Other verbs have irregular affirmative forms. I see - I saw
points.uz: Boshqa fe'llarning noto'g'ri tasdiq shakli bor.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 2-QOIDA.
see → SAW.  Ro'yxat kitob oxirida.

points.en: We form the interrogative of past simple with did + subject pronoun + base form of the verb. Did he work yesterday? Did you see Tom yesterday?
points.uz: So'roqni did + kishilik olmoshi + fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 3-QOIDA.
'base form' = ASOSIY shakl (work, see).
'Did you saw?' XATO.

points.en: We form the negative of past simple with didn't + base form of the verb. I didn't work yesterday. I didn't see Tom yesterday.
points.uz: Inkorni didn't + fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 4-QOIDA.
'I didn't saw' XATO.

points.en: We form positive short answers with did and negative short answers with didn't. Did you call me? Yes, I did. Did he tell you? No, he didn't.
points.uz: Ijobiy qisqa javobni did, salbiyni didn't bilan yasaymiz.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 5-QOIDA.
Asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI UCH QOIDA:

  1) Oxiri -E bilan tugagan fe'lga -D qo'shamiz.
        I live  →  I lived

  2) UNDOSH + Y bilan tugagan fe'lda -Y tushadi,
     o'rniga -IED qo'shiladi.
        I marry  →  I married

  3) IKKI UNDOSH ORASIDA BITTA URG'ULI UNLI bo'lgan
     fe'lda oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI, so'ng -ED qo'shiladi.
        I stop  →  I stopped

3-QOIDANI BATAFSIL TUSHUNTIRAMIZ:

  'stop' so'zini ko'ring:  s-T-O-P
     'o' — unli, ikki tomonida undosh (t va p)
     va u URG'ULI (bir bo'g'inli so'z — urg'u shu yerda)
     → oxirgi undosh 'p' IKKILANADI → stoPPed

  Boshqa misollar:
     plan  → planned   (a — urg'uli, n ikkilanadi)
     stop  → stopped
     shop  → shopped
     drop  → dropped

  IKKILANMAYDIGAN holatlar:
     visit  → visited   (urg'u BIRINCHI bo'g'inda: VI-sit)
     open   → opened    (urg'u birinchi bo'g'inda: O-pen)
     rain   → rained    (ikki unli: 'ai')
     work   → worked    (ikki undosh: 'rk')

  BRITANCHA ISTISNO:
     travel → travelled  (britanchada L DOIM ikkilanadi,
                          urg'u birinchi bo'g'inda bo'lsa ham)
     Amerikachada: traveled.

QO'ShIMCHA (kitobda yo'q, lekin bilish kerak):
  UNLI + Y bo'lsa, -Y QOLADI:
     play → played;  enjoy → enjoyed;  stay → stayed

points.en: We add -d to verbs ending in -e. I live - I lived
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 1-QOIDA.
'liveed' EMAS.
love → loved;  care → cared;  die → died.

points.en: Verbs ending in a consonant + y drop the -y and add -ied. I marry - I married
points.uz: Undosh + y bilan tugagan fe'lda -y tushib, -ied qo'shiladi.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 2-QOIDA.
study → studied;  bury → buried;  tidy → tidied.
DIQQAT: UNLI + y bo'lsa -y QOLADI (play → played).

points.en: Verbs ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants double the last consonant and add -ed. I stop - I stopped
points.uz: Ikki undosh orasida bitta urg'uli unli bo'lgan fe'lda oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 3-QOIDA.
stop → stopped;  plan → planned;  shop → shopped.
DIQQAT: urg'u OXIRGI bo'g'inda bo'lishi kerak —
'visit' da urg'u birinchi bo'g'inda → visited (ikkilanmaydi).

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA (Use):

  Oddiy o'tgan zamonni O'TMISHDA ANIQ BIR VAQTDA
  sodir bo'lgan yoki tugagan harakatlar uchun ishlatamiz.

     He GRADUATED in 1998.
     (When did he graduate? In 1998.)

  ENG MUHIM SO'Z: 'a DEFINITE time' = ANIQ vaqt.
  Ya'ni voqea QACHON bo'lgani ma'lum.

VAQT IBORALARI (past simple bilan ishlatiladi):

  yesterday                      kecha
  last night                     kecha kechqurun
  last week / year / Monday      o'tgan hafta/yil/dushanba
  a month ago                    bir oy oldin
  two years ago                  ikki yil oldin
  three years ago                uch yil oldin
  in 1964                        1964-yilda

IKKI GURUH — JOYI HAR XIL:

  'LAST ...' → gap OXIRIDA yoki BOSHIDA
     I saw him last week.
     Last week I saw him.

  '... AGO' → 'ago' DOIM oxirida turadi
     I saw him two years AGO.
     'ago two years' XATO.

DIQQAT — 'LAST' va 'AGO' BIRGA ISHLATILMAYDI:
     last week        ✓
     a week ago       ✓
     last week ago    ✗ XATO

DIQQAT — 'IN + YIL':
     in 1964, in 1998 — yil oldidan DOIM IN.

YANGI SO'Z:
  to graduate = (o'quv yurtini) tugatmoq, bitirmoq
  a graduate  = bitiruvchi
exercises.bookRef: Grammar Book, 42-bet, Use va Time Expressions

points.en: We use the past simple for actions which happened or finished at a definite time in the past.
points.uz: Oddiy o'tgan zamonni o'tmishda aniq bir vaqtda sodir bo'lgan yoki tugagan harakatlar uchun ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA.
'a definite time' = ANIQ vaqt.

points.en: He graduated in 1998. (When did he graduate? In 1998.)
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI MISOL.
'to graduate' = o'quv yurtini tugatmoq.
Qavs ichida savol-javob bilan 'aniq vaqt' ko'rsatilgan.

points.en: yesterday
points.noteUz: Gap oxirida yoki boshida turadi.

points.en: last night / week / year / Monday
points.uz: kecha kechqurun / o'tgan hafta / yil / dushanba
points.noteUz: 'last' — predlogsiz, 'in last week' XATO.

points.en: a month / two years / three years ago
points.uz: bir oy / ikki yil / uch yil oldin
points.noteUz:
'ago' DOIM oxirida.
'last' bilan BIRGA ishlatilmaydi.
Yil oldidan DOIM IN.

exercises.explanationUz:
ASOSIY QOIDA:

  A/AN — biror narsa haqida BIRINCHI MARTA gapirganda
  THE  — ILGARI AYTILGAN narsa haqida gapirganda

  MISOL:
     There's A dog in the garden.       (birinchi marta)
     THE dog is near the swimming-pool. (o'sha it)

THE QO'YILADI:

  • daryo nomlari      → the Nile, the Amazon
  • dengiz nomlari     → the Mediterranean Sea
  • okean nomlari      → the Pacific, the Atlantic
  • tog' tizmalari     → the Himalayas, the Alps
  • millat nomlari     → the Polish, the Italians
  • oila nomlari       → the Johnsons, the Browns
  • qabila nomlari     → the Navajo, the Inuit

THE QO'YILMAYDI:

  • atoqli otlar       → Paul, Warsaw
  • mamlakat nomlari   → Spain, Turkey
  • ovqat nomlari      → dinner, breakfast
  • sport/o'yin nomlari → basketball, cards

ESLATMA — 'THE INUIT':
  Workbook 39-betdagi matn aynan inuitlar haqida edi.
  Qabila nomi bo'lgani uchun 'THE Inuit' deb yoziladi.

ESLATMA — MILLAT NOMLARIDA IKKI SHAKL:
  the Polish   — 'the' + SIFAT (butun xalq)
  the Italians — 'the' + KO'PLIK OT (butun xalq)
  Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri, faqat shakli boshqacha.

A yoki AN — TOVUShGA qaraladi, yozilishga emas:
  UNDOSH tovush → A   (a dog, a university /juː/)
  UNLI tovush   → AN  (an egg, an hour /aʊ/ — 'h' jim)

DIQQAT — MAMLAKAT NOMLARIDAGI ISTISNO:
  Oddiy nomlarda THE yo'q: Spain, Turkey, Uzbekistan
  Lekin ko'plik yoki 'union/kingdom/republic' bo'lsa THE:
     the USA, the UK, the Netherlands, the Philippines

points.en: We use a/an to talk about something for the first time.
points.uz: A/an ni birinchi marta aytilgan narsa uchun ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz: KITOBDAGI 1-QOIDA.

points.en: We use the to talk about something we have mentioned before.
points.uz: The ni ilgari aytilgan narsa uchun ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz: KITOBDAGI 2-QOIDA.

points.en: There's a dog in the garden. The dog is near the swimming-pool.
points.uz: Bog'da it bor. It suzish havzasi yonida.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI MISOL — A → THE o'zgarishi.
DIQQAT: 'the garden' da ham THE bor —
chunki gaplashuvchilar qaysi bog' ekanini bilishadi.

points.en: names of rivers: the Nile, the Amazon
points.noteUz:
THE SHART.
the Thames, the Volga, the Amu Darya.

points.en: names of seas: the Mediterranean Sea
points.noteUz:
THE SHART.
the Black Sea, the Red Sea, the Aral Sea.

points.en: names of oceans: the Pacific, the Atlantic
points.noteUz:
THE SHART.
the Indian Ocean, the Arctic Ocean.

points.en: names of mountain ranges: the Himalayas, the Alps
points.noteUz:
THE SHART va odatda KO'PLIK.
DIQQAT: BITTA tog'da THE YO'Q — Mount Everest.

points.en: nationalities: the Polish, the Italians
points.noteUz:
THE SHART (butun xalq ma'nosida).
'the Polish' — sifat shakli;  'the Italians' — ko'plik ot.

points.en: names of families: the Johnsons, the Browns
points.noteUz:
THE SHART + KO'PLIK -S.
'the Browns' = Braunlar oilasi.

points.en: names of tribes: the Navajo, the Inuit
points.noteUz:
THE SHART.
'the Inuit' — Workbook 39-betdagi matnning mavzusi.
'the Navajo' — Shimoliy Amerika hindulari.

points.en: proper nouns: Paul, Warsaw
points.noteUz:
THE QO'YILMAYDI.
Odam ismlari va shahar nomlari.
'Warsaw' = Varshava (Mari Kyurining vatani).

points.en: names of countries: Spain, Turkey
points.noteUz:
THE QO'YILMAYDI.
ISTISNO: the USA, the UK, the Netherlands.

points.en: names of meals: dinner, breakfast
points.noteUz:
THE QO'YILMAYDI.
have breakfast, have dinner.

points.en: names of sports/games: basketball, cards
points.noteUz:
THE QO'YILMAYDI.
play basketball, play cards.
DIQQAT: cholg'u asboblarida esa THE SHART —
play THE piano.

exercises.explanationUz:
'THE' IKKI XIL O'QILADI:

  /ðə/  — UNDOSH tovush bilan boshlangan so'z oldidan
           the glass  /ðə ɡlɑːs/
           the baby   /ðə ˈbeɪbi/

  /ðiː/ — UNLI tovush bilan boshlangan so'z oldidan
           the egg    /ðiː eɡ/
           the apple  /ðiː ˈæpl/

QOIDA 'A/AN' BILAN BIR XIL MANTIQDA:
  a dog / an egg
  the /ðə/ dog / the /ðiː/ egg

DIQQAT — TOVUShGA QARALADI, HARFGA EMAS:

  'university' — U harfi bilan boshlanadi, lekin
     /juːnɪˈvɜːsɪti/ deb o'qiladi — 'y' TOVUSHI (undosh).
     → A university,  the /ðə/ university

  'hour' — H harfi bilan boshlanadi, lekin
     /aʊə/ deb o'qiladi — 'h' JIM, unli tovush.
     → AN hour,  the /ðiː/ hour

  'honest' — 'h' jim → an honest man, the /ðiː/ honest man

AMALIY MASLAHAT:
  So'zni ovoz chiqarib ayting. Birinchi TOVUSH unli bo'lsa
  → /ðiː/;  undosh bo'lsa → /ðə/.

points.en: The is pronounced /ðə/ before words which begin with a consonant sound: the glass, the baby
points.uz: 'the' undosh tovush bilan boshlangan so'z oldidan /ðə/ deb o'qiladi.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 1-QOIDA.
Qisqa, kuchsiz talaffuz.

points.en: The is pronounced /ðiː/ before words which begin with a vowel sound: the egg, the apple
points.uz: 'the' unli tovush bilan boshlangan so'z oldidan /ðiː/ deb o'qiladi.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 2-QOIDA.
Uzun 'i' tovushi.

points.en: a university → the /ðə/ university
points.noteUz:
TOVUShGA qaraladi: /juː/ — UNDOSH tovush.
Shuning uchun 'A university' va /ðə/.

points.en: an hour → the /ðiː/ hour
points.noteUz:
'h' O'QILMAYDI → /aʊə/ — UNLI tovush.
Shuning uchun 'AN hour' va /ðiː/.

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL — UZUN va QISQA SHAKLLAR:

  TASDIQ                        INKOR
  UZUN          QISQA           UZUN            QISQA
  I will go     I'll go         I will not go   I won't go
  you will go   you'll go       you will not go you won't go
  he will go    he'll go        he will not go  he won't go
  she will go   she'll go       she will not go she won't go
  it will go    it'll go        it will not go  it won't go
  we will go    we'll go        we will not go  we won't go
  you will go   you'll go       you will not go you won't go
  they will go  they'll go      they will not go they won't go

UCH MUHIM QOIDA:

  1) 'WILL' HAMMA EGA UCHUN BIR XIL.
        he wills  ✗ XATO

  2) 'will' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda, 'to' SIZ:
        He will GO.        ✓
        He will TO go.     ✗ XATO
        He will GOES.      ✗ XATO
        He will WENT.      ✗ XATO

  3) SO'ROQda 'do/does/did' KERAK EMAS —
     'will' o'zi gap boshiga chiqadi:
        WILL he go?        ✓
        Does he will go?   ✗ XATO

QISQARTMALAR:
  I will   → I'LL      /aɪl/
  you will → YOU'LL    /juːl/
  he will  → HE'LL     /hiːl/
  she will → SHE'LL
  it will  → IT'LL
  we will  → WE'LL     /wiːl/
  they will → THEY'LL

  will not → WON'T     /wəʊnt/
  DIQQAT: 'willn't' shakli YO'Q!
  'won't' — yozilishi butunlay boshqacha, yodlash kerak.

ISHLATILISHI — BASHORAT:
  'will' ni kelajak haqidagi FIKR va TAXMIN uchun
  ishlatamiz.
     I think it will rain tomorrow.
     Perhaps they will win the match.

BASHORAT SO'ZLARI ('will' bilan birga):
  I think ...   = menimcha
  I hope ...    = umid qilaman
  Perhaps ...   = ehtimol
  Maybe ...     = balki
  I'm sure ...  = ishonchim komil

points.en: I will go — I'll go
points.noteUz: Qisqa shakl: I'll /aɪl/.

points.en: you will go — you'll go
he will go — he'll go
points.noteUz: DIQQAT: -S YO'Q ('he wills' XATO).

points.en: she will go — she'll go
it will go — it'll go
we will go — we'll go
they will go — they'll go
I will not go — I won't go
points.noteUz:
INKOR qisqartmasi: WON'T /wəʊnt/.
'willn't' shakli YO'Q — yodlash kerak.

points.en: he will not go — he won't go
points.noteUz: Hamma ega uchun 'won't' bir xil.

points.en: they will not go — they won't go
Will he go? (not: Does he will go?)
points.noteUz:
SO'ROQda 'will' gap boshiga chiqadi.
'do/does/did' KERAK EMAS.

points.en: We use will to make predictions.
points.noteUz:
Kelajak haqidagi fikr va taxmin.
Coursebook 69-betda ham shu qoida berilgan.

patterns.formula: Ega + fe'l+ED.   /   DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?   /   Ega + DIDN'T + ASOSIY fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: I worked yesterday. Did he work yesterday? I didn't work yesterday.
patterns.exampleUz: Kecha ishladim. U kecha ishladimi? Kecha ishlamadim.

patterns.formula: DID + ega + SEE ...?  →  Yes, I DID. / No, I DIDN'T.
patterns.exampleEn: Did you see Tom yesterday? — Yes, I did.
patterns.explanationUz:
Noto'g'ri fe'lda ham so'roqda ASOSIY shakl ('see').
Qisqa javobda faqat 'did'.

patterns.formula: There's A + ot ... . THE + o'sha ot ... .
patterns.exampleEn: There's a dog in the garden. The dog is near the swimming-pool.
patterns.exampleUz: Bog'da it bor. It suzish havzasi yonida.
patterns.explanationUz: Birinchi marta → A/AN;  ikkinchi marta → THE.

patterns.formula: Ega + WILL + ASOSIY fe'l.   /   Ega + WON'T + ASOSIY fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: He will go. He won't go.
patterns.explanationUz:
'will' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda, 'to' siz.
Hamma ega uchun bir xil.
